propositions: 836 duplicate bridge-echo comments lacking the reconciler marker exist across three Jira issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) because truncation to 32767 characters removes the marker appended after the body

The identification rule requires both the truncation suffix and absence of the reconciler marker; the marker is missing due to outbound truncation cutting it off post-body-append, not foreign authorship

For each distinct normalized comment body, the oldest copy (lowest Jira comment id) must survive; post-re-enable bridge passes will re-post these comments once before deduplication takes effect from pass 2 onward

The final sweep after re-enabling must invert the keep-rule to preserve the comment id recorded by the bridge, not the oldest copy, because _record_comment_id only records on new posts and does not backfill
827 truncated duplicate comments were successfully deleted across the three issues with zero data loss, verified by reconciliation of backup minus deleted equaling observed post-deletion state
